name: MCPJam platform lane guard failing closed
aplQuery: | where msg contains '"event":"insight_reservation_failed"' or msg contains '"event":"insight_lane_settle_failed"' or msg contains '"event":"platform_lane_scan_bounded"'
description: PAGE · The lane reservation guard failed closed in the last 5 minutes: a hold could not be written or settled, or a lane scan hit its row bound. Included AI is being refused, or holds are stranding, for reasons that do NOT lift at midnight.
TRIAGE — open View Query, replace the last line with:
| summarize n=count() by event, feature, error
rationale: WHY THIS EXISTS: these three events are the guard itself breaking, not a customer at a cap. reservation_failed refuses work a customer was entitled to; settle_failed strands a hold until the UTC roll; scan_bounded refuses a whole lane.
WHY ANY OCCURRENCE: none should happen in normal operation. If one proves to be a benign transient, raise the threshold with a measured reason rather than muting it.

SOURCE IS NEW: emitted by mcpjam-backend #1463 (lane events, usage funding) and #1470 (snapshot). Until both are in PROD this query returns no rows — an Above monitor stays silent and the deadman would page falsely. Apply only after the prod deploy, with --only <key>.
